meta.name: ulw-execute
meta.description: Execute a Prometheus work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger updates, worktree discipline, parallel subagents, and Stop-hook continuation. Use after planning when the user says ulw-execute, execute plan, continue plan, resume plan, or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动执行开发计划，并行调度多个子代理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你希望让代理按既定计划自动推进开发任务。
copy.tagline_en: Execute your development plan automatically while coordinating parallel subagents.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to follow a defined plan and handle multiple subtasks in parallel.

howto.what: 装上此技能后，当你要求执行或继续工作计划时，Claude 会当编排者：选定 .omo/plans/ 下的计划，把复选框拆成小任务，并行派多个子代理实现和验证，直到全部完成；它自己不写代码，只记录状态、检查结果，若指定 PR 模式再以 PR/合并收尾。
howto.when: 在规划后，当你提到 ulw-execute、execute plan、continue plan 等启动词，或要求运行 .omo/plans 下的某个计划时触发；若无现成计划却明确要求开工，会先引导生成计划再执行。

say.text: 执行 .omo/plans 文件里的 login-fix 计划
say.note: 选出该计划并把剩余复选任务拆给子代理并行做。
实现完会开出一个 PR 交给你审阅合并。
有未完成工作时接着做，直到全部复选框完成。

howto.what_en: Claude orchestrates: it selects a .omo/plans plan, splits checkbox tasks, spawns parallel subagents to implement and verify until done. It never writes code itself; it tracks state, checks results, and optionally opens a PR or merges.
howto.when_en: When you say ulw-execute, execute plan or continue plan after planning, or ask to run a .omo/plans plan, it takes over. If no plan exists but start work is explicit, it creates one first.

say_en.note: It chooses that plan and runs subagents in parallel.
After implementation it opens a PR for review.
It resumes remaining work until all checkboxes are done.
